adjudication.evidence: P1 (666–719) shows a sustained offset in U (~+10 mm) and N/E shifts, but no clear return; P2 (719) is a single-point spike with opposite sign but no sustained platform; P3 (729) is also a single point with negligible offset. Original N/E/U show smooth motion across 719–729 with no opposing return for P1, and no persistent interior level shift supporting a temporary platform. The onset-offset estimates are distorted by nearby steps and missing data (e.g., indices 653–658, 667). No genuine temporary platform is supported by sustained shift + return across same axes.
